segments.text: The rounding bug cost us two days of support time. Let us start with what we saw first.
Our regression suite had no case with a price like nine ninety-nine times three.
I can add a set of awkward prices to the shared test data today.
And a rule: any change to totals needs a second pair of eyes before the release.
Support asked for a banner when a known issue is open. That would have saved many tickets.
